newsitem.title: USA: Viacom's MTV wants to set site fee - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Viacom's MTV wants to set site fee - WSJ.

text.p: Music video network MTV Networks of Viacom Inc wants to get computer on-line services to pay multi-million-dollar fees or risk having their users blocked from viewing the network's site on the World Wide Web, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The newspaper described MTV's approach as controversial, explaining how most sites offer free access because they generate revenue from advertising on the sites.
It said MTV's model was similar to local cable operators paying a fee to show a channel like MTV on their networks.
